name: DICE AND DOMINOES
description: Dice and Dominoes is a western domino table game that combines domino connecting play with an auxiliary dice-driven table profile for pace or scoring. This entry models the connecting core using two double-six sets; dice effects are treated as a configurable profile layer rather than changing tile legality.

content.text: Dice and Dominoes is a western domino table game that combines domino connecting play with an auxiliary dice-driven table profile for pace or scoring. This entry models the connecting core using two double-six sets; dice effects are treated as a configurable profile layer rather than changing tile legality.
Dice-and-domino formats are encountered as modern table variants that add a dice layer to classic connecting play for pacing, constraints, or scoring tweaks.
Two double-6 domino sets combined and mixed.
Domino sets plus dice as required by the active table profile.
Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles may form a boneyard by table profile.
